pages.raw_title: Who We Are | About Us | Equifax
pages.raw_meta: Discover who we are and how Equifax positively impacts pivotal moments in people's lives. As a global data, analytics, and technology company, we empower businesses in diverse industries, provide insights to make smarter decisions, and strive to create economically healthy individuals and communities. Watch our video to see the difference we make
raw_blocks: We help people live their financial best
As a trusted global leader in data, analytics, and technology we deliver insights that power decisions to move people forward.
Positive Economic Change Starts With a Single Opportunity
See how Equifax insights drive and support life’s pivotal moments.
Our Commitments Reflect Our Values
We are nearly 15,000 bright minds determined to do the right thing and put people first as we strive to create economically healthy individuals and communities everywhere we do business.
29.5 Million U.S. consumers obtained loans to buy a car and 9.2M U.S. consumers secured a mortgage or home equity loan¹
The Work Number supported instant income and employment verifications for 58 million people outside of regular business hours²
$4 Billion + instances of online identity protection¹
$2.6M total U.S. community impact of the Equifax Foundation and Equifax Gives²
We Help Businesses Make Smarter Decisions Faster
We are constantly driving technological change to meet the evolving needs of our customers and consumers around the world.
Our unique blend of differentiated data and advanced analytics enables us to deliver insights that power intelligent decisions and create opportunity.
See How We Do It
Explore Our Latest News and More
Nurturing a culture of inclusivity and innovation
Helping people take control of their financial well-being
Join the team and power your possible

¹BASED ON ACTUAL AND ESTIMATED RESULTS FROM JANUARY-DECEMBER 2025 Sources: Data and analytics captured by Equifax business units (U.S. Information Solutions, Workforce Solutions, and International) ²As reported in the Equifax 2026 Proxy Statement .

As a global data, analytics, and technology company, we play an essential role in the economy by helping companies in diverse industries such as automotive, communications, utilities, financial services, fintech, healthcare, insurance, mortgage, professional services, retail, e-commerce, and government agencies, make critical decisions with greater confidence.

Our unique blend of differentiated data, analytics, and technology lets us create the insights that power decisions to move people forward. We help businesses provide a seamless and positive experience during life’s pivotal moments — like applying for a job or mortgage, financing an education, or buying a car.

How does Equifax positively impact some of life’s most pivotal moments? Watch this video to learn how we help move people forward by powering our customers with the insights they need to make smarter decisions for their customers, and for consumers around the world.
Latin American consumers gained access to credit
People in the United States secured a loan to further their education
Completed know-your-customer verification checks for customers in Canada
United States consumers secured a mortgage or a home equity loan
Consumer credit card files were delivered to United States lenders
Helped United Kingdom consumers get a credit card
BASED ON ACTUAL AND ESTIMATED RESULTS FROM JANUARY-DECEMBER 2022 Sources: Data and analytics captured by Equifax business units (U.S. Information Solutions, Workforce Solutions, and International)
Be leaders in security and trusted data stewards. Lead with integrity, be personally accountable. Hold high standards in markets around the world.
Exceed customer expectations every day. Deliver value and quality so we grow together. Aspire to be our customers' first call.
Deliver results and play to win. Drive excellent execution. Have a sense of urgency, agility and grit.
Work together as one global team. Assume best intentions from each other. Foster optimism and have fun together.
Be intellectually curious and insights driven. Optimize data and technology to sustain leadership. Drive scalable, profitable growth.
Take initiative to develop ourselves, and others. Value diversity of experience and thought. Proudly show Equifax spirit at work and in communities.
We are a group of the best and brightest in our fields. Our team of experts encourage each other to be our best and are passionate about helping people.
Your growth is our team’s success. We recognize and reward our team’s achievements, and our people are as diverse as the 24 countries we operate in and the thousands of career opportunities we offer.
Powered by the Equifax Cloud
We've transformed our company and how we work with the Equifax Cloud™, bringing our team the agility, flexibility and opportunity to innovate faster.

Equifax serves consumers and business customers through three business units. Each business unit focuses on the needs of unique market segments, putting customers first in everything they do. They are each aligned to our strategic priorities — accelerating innovation and driving new products and services built on the Equifax Cloud ™ .

Providing U.S. consumers and businesses with a wide range of solutions — from consumer credit monitoring and identity theft prevention to business risk information, commercial identity & fraud solutions, financial marketing and analytical services.
Workforce Solutions Partnering with thousands of businesses across the U.S. and government entities to provide human resource, employment, tax, management, and payroll-related services.
International Leveraging unique data sources and analytics to provide consumers, business, government entities around the world with more access to credit and financial opportunity.
The Equifax Cloud™ is the foundation of our business. It is the result of our investment to create a world class enterprise-wide infrastructure tailored to highly regulated data workloads.

Only Equifax has a powerful combination of differentiated data, advanced analytics, a cloud-native data fabric and scalable global platforms. Equifax brings unrivaled decision intelligence to a wide spectrum of global customers in industries ranging from lending and fraud detection and prevention to HR management, marketing and more.
Gain more predictive power. Make smarter, faster decisions with direct access to superior data and analytics to understand business and consumer behavior for better lending outcomes.
Confidently verify employment, income, and education information for credit products, mortgages, and government programs with more comprehensive insights delivered seamlessly and quickly.

Turn marketing precision into customer value with data-driven solutions and a unique understanding of household economics. From prospect identification and qualification through origination, and activation — we can help navigate each phase of the acquisition path.

Deliver a great employee experience and meet compliance needs with award-winning HR technology that supports every stage of the employment life cycle; from talent acquisition and onboarding through active service and post-employment.

Better insights mean better business. Gain visibility into customers and prospects at the point of interaction — verify and authenticate identity, assess fraud risk, understand device risk, and help ensure regulatory compliance. We offer powerful solutions to mitigate fraud risk.
We’ve completely rebuilt our security and technology systems and are continuously investing in the very best processes, technology and protocols to secure your information.
We conduct rigorous, frequent and thorough technology and regulatory auditing which gives us full visibility into the data that is coming in and out of our environment.
A cloud-native technology stack provides the opportunity to exceed an on-premise security posture when combined with the implementation of our rigorous security controls.
We can quickly and more accurately devalue data to the point that it is useless to attackers.
Our state-of-the-art cyberfusion center and cybersecurity talent successfully defend against millions of threats every day.

At Equifax, innovation is built into our data and analytics. Our data scientists, engineers and developers use artificial intelligence and machine learning to enrich the solutions our customers need to grow, protect and manage their businesses. We innovate with speed at scale to accelerate results for our customers and help them bring new opportunities to consumers. Many Equifax innovative technologies are patented or patent pending. Learn More .
Active patents and current patent applications across the enterprise.
More consumers with little to no credit history can gain access to credit when lenders use our patented explainable AI technology and alternative data.
New products delivered in 2022.

In 2020, the Equifax Foundation gave nearly $1.7 million in direct grants and $840,000 in matching gifts to organizations of our employees’ choosing. We believe that credit building can be a tool for tackling income inequality and decreasing the racial wealth gap. We are proud to have helped thousands of our neighbors through our multi-year partnerships with Greater Atlanta Builds Credit and St. Louis Builds Credit. In addition to our significant relationships with Invest America, MoCaFi, Prosperity Connection, Quest Communities, the Tower Grove Neighborhood CDC and the Westside Future Fund, Equifax has heavily invested in the On the Rise Financial Center. Through On the Rise, we are helping people in the Atlanta area earn economic independence through free financial coaching, homebuyer education and money management tools.

raw_blocks: Equifax Consumer Services LLC Licenses and Disclosures

Equifax Consumer Services LLC (“we,” “us,” “our” and “ECS”), which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Equifax Inc. (“Equifax”), is a Georgia limited liability company with its principal place of business located at 1201 West Peachtree Street NW, Suite 2200, Mail Stop 22A, Atlanta GA, US 30309.

ECS provides lead generation services for banks, state licensed lenders, marketers and brokers to market loan products to consumers in certain states, including personal loans, auto loans, and credit cards through various Equifax channels, including through the Equifax public website ( https://equifax.com ), the myEquifax account center website available to certain consumers, and by email.

In some states, our services may require us to obtain licenses or register as a loan broker or hold some similar state license in order to advertise or market the availability of credit offers or generate leads for credit products, and we have provided the list of licenses and registrations we currently hold below.

However, we are not a lender and we do not take applications for credit, make any credit decisions, negotiate loans, issue loan approvals, fund loans, service loans, or enter into loan broker agreements with consumers. We do not charge consumers any fees or other consideration in connection with our lead generation services.

If you visit a loan broker’s or lender’s website through an offer or advertisement we present to you, you will be required to provide additional information to the loan broker or lender to complete an application for credit.
North Carolina Loan Broker Registration No. 1044
DISCLOSURES REQUIRED BY NORTH CAROLINA LAW

THE STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA HAS NOT REVIEWED AND DOES NOT APPROVE, RECOMMEND, ENDORSE OR SPONSOR ANY LOAN BROKERAGE CONTRACT. THE INFORMATION CONTAINED IN THIS DISCLOSURE HAS NOT BEEN VERIFIED BY THE STATE. IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS SEE AN ATTORNEY BEFORE YOU SIGN A CONTRACT OR AGREEMENT.

As required by North Carolina law, ECS has secured a bond by LIBERTY MUTUAL INSURANCE COMPANY, 175 Berkeley Street, Boston, MA 02116, a surety authorized to do business in the State of North Carolina.
